scientific_question: Estimate deployed-checkpoint Bits-Per-Byte (BPB) on fresh post-cutoff human text from Direct OpenAI /v1/responses using 1 unconstrained call per position (top_logprobs=20, zero forbidden interventions).

pricing_guard.source: Conservative Standard list prices for gpt-5.6-sol (checked 2026-09-05); applied conservatively even to Flex requests.

scope_boundaries: Measures deployed post-trained checkpoint BPB, not base pretraining perplexity.
Does not use Structured Outputs, logit_bias, or frequency penalties (closed by prior Sol audits).
Treats whole documents/requests as the independent statistical unit via document-level bootstrap.
Must pass open-model ground-truth gate before quoting closed-model point rankings.
